_comment: OPTIONAL seccomp profile — NOT enabled by default, and that is deliberate:
the Docker/Podman default seccomp profile is well maintained and already
blocks the dangerous syscalls. Only use a custom profile if you have a
concrete reason (do not leave the default profile without need).
This example is a DENY-list layered on an allow-all default. That makes it
strictly WEAKER than the runtime default profile on its own — its purpose
is documentation: it names the syscalls that matter for container escape.
If you want belt-and-suspenders, start from the runtime's default profile
and REMOVE syscalls, rather than enabling this file.
